entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Nullability analysis doesn't quite work for user-defined conversions involved into tuple value conversions #81675
  • Thousands of phantom IntelliSense errors on VS 2026 #81674
  • Unexpected diagnostic in `with` expression with indexer on a struct #81666
    Backlog

Closed

  • EnC analyzer reports duplicate semantic diagnostics #36061
    Backlog
  • Extension blocks are not respected for sticky scroll #81662
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11311.198 #81672
  • CS1574 reports for C#14 extension #81665
  • Extension property incorrectly resolved to same named static method #81656
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11311.85 #81661

PullRequests

Created

  • Hot Reload: Misc small tweaks #81676
    Area-Interactive, VSCode

Merged

  • Speed up analyzer-based tests by 6x #81673
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Port IDE `with(...)` features to new feature branch. #81671
    VSCode
  • Remove unneeded MEF component #81663
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Add code-folding/structure-guides/sticky-scroll support for extension blocks #81667
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • *** WIP -- DeclarationTable allocation reductions #81627

    Area-IDE
  • Track sourceLink and resources in deterministic key #81629
    Area-Compilers, Concept-Determinism
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers

    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Extension indexers: allow and resolve extension indexers #81607
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Unsafe evolution: check caller unsafe context for usages of some methods and properties #81581
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [WIP] Consolidate ExternalAccess libraries #81593
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Improve error recovery around 'scoped' modifier parsing #81636
    Area-Compilers

  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
